resources.string:
Rewordium's writing assistant helps you rewrite, fix grammar, change tone and draft smart replies inside your other apps.

What it accesses: it notices when you're in a text field so it can show the floating assistant. When you use the assistant, it reads the text in that field and, for smart replies, the recent messages visible in that conversation.

How it's used: only the text you ask it to work on is sent to Rewordium's AI provider to write the suggestion, and the result is placed back in the field when you choose it. It isn't used for ads or sold, and Rewordium doesn't keep the text after your request.

You can turn this service off at any time.
